newsitem.title: USA: Scripps Bank reports Q1 results.
newsitem.headline: Scripps Bank reports Q1 results.

text.p: Scripps Bank on Tuesday posted first-quarter net income of $588,000, or $0.25 per share, compared with net income of $569,000, or $0.37, for the same period of 1996.
The decline in earnings per share reflected the sale of 680,000 new shares of common stock through a private placement with the Thomas W. Sefton Trust and a rights/nonrights offering in mid-1996.
Net loans rose 39.5 percent to $188,941,000 from $135,467,000. Net deposits rose 21.7 percent to $281,583,000 from $231,419,000, and total assets rose 24.7 percent to $310,633,000.from $249,024,000.
